requirement: The checker must read `book.src` from `book.toml` (default `src`) and inspect local chapters linked from that directory’s `SUMMARY.md`, including nested chapters, while skipping draft and external links and unlisted files.
justification: Scenarios: explicit/default source directory, nested local links, fragments, absent drafts, external URI schemes, unlisted files and parent-relative links. discover obtains src from TOML and only visits SUMMARY link targets; read_book resolves contained parent paths without applying the stricter evidence-input policy. The tests verify exactly the expected discovered IDs and reject repository escapes. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions. Reviewed the cited assertions after the test edit: their code is byte-identical; only line positions moved, with no behavioral change. All 21 checker tests passed with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml.
